iterations.label: Iterations per set
iterations.help: Each set is simulated multiple times. More iterations reduce variation in the results, but take longer.
iterations.blocked: Free is limited to {count} iterations. Your simulation will run with {count} per set.

accuracy.500: Quick estimate — fastest comparison, with more variation between runs.
accuracy.1000: Improved precision — less random variation than 500 iterations.
accuracy.1500: Steadier results — more consistent estimates for similar gear sets.
accuracy.2000: Higher precision — reduces noise when comparing small DPS differences.
accuracy.2500: Finer comparison — more sampling for closely matched gear sets.
accuracy.3000: Most stable estimate — lowest sampling noise here, with the longest run time.
